doc: FBL 0.12, section 4.9 (segments in any order) and section 5.2 (a many attribute's {node} slot), FR-024: etalii.adp.ide.standalone/src/diagrams/wardley-map/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.WardleyMap.Tests/Fixtures/decorators.owm at ad1a4680a, unchanged. A component's decorators are one set, read in written order: all five on Everything, one the tool type does not know on Unknown (an item as written), one written twice on Repeated (two items), and decorators around inertia on Reordered. A set writes the difference: one removed with the whitespace before it, one added right after the last one, or, on a component with none, after its coordinates.

steps.doc: Reordered's decorators set from outsource and market to market and buy: (outsource) is removed with the space before it, and (buy) is added right after (market), the last one; inertia between them stays.
steps.expect:
title Decorators
anchor User [0.95, 0.5]
component Everything [0.8, 0.5] (market) (ecosystem) (build) (buy) (outsource)
component Unknown [0.7, 0.4] (someDecoratorFromLater)
component Repeated [0.6, 0.3] (build) (build)
component Reordered [0.5, 0.6] inertia (market) (buy)
component Plain [0.4, 0.7]
User->Everything

steps.doc: The undo removes (buy) and puts (outsource) back.
